towns.name: Havenwood
towns.description: A scenic river town with a mix of old-world charm and modern commerce.

towns.name: Port St. Jude
towns.description: A bustling coastal city and major economic hub with a diverse population.

towns.name: Whispering Pines
towns.description: A quiet, remote mountain community known for its natural beauty.

scenarios.title: The Midtown Fault Line
scenarios.description: A previously unknown fault line shifts beneath the city's financial district, damaging rigid structures and data centers.

impacts.impactDescription: Havenwood's downtown lacks modern seismic codes, and its economic district relies on older, rigid structures that are highly susceptible to damage from this kind of quake.

Due to its role as a major financial hub, Port St. Jude's downtown is densely packed with tall, vulnerable buildings and critical data infrastructure that are at high risk from this inland fault line event.

While its buildings are lower, Whispering Pines' remote location means a longer emergency response time. The city's reliance on a single major access road makes it difficult to bring in aid when the road is impassable.

scenarios.title: The Liquefaction Event
scenarios.description: A moderate earthquake causes the ground to turn into a liquid-like substance, buckling roads and utility lines in coastal industrial zones.

impacts.impactDescription: As an inland town, Havenwood's infrastructure is largely unaffected by the liquefaction near the coast, but it still suffers from supply chain disruptions due to damaged external transit routes.

Port St. Jude's heavy industrial port and extensive coastal infrastructure are built on reclaimed land, making them extremely susceptible to liquefaction. This event severely impacts their logistics and economy.
Being a mountain town, Whispering Pines has no risk of liquefaction. Its primary impact comes from disrupted goods coming up from the coast, causing short-term shortages and a loss of public trust.

scenarios.title: The Upriver Surge
scenarios.description: An offshore tsunami is funneled inland by a river's estuary, causing flash flooding in a town located on its upper banks.

impacts.impactDescription: Located on the banks of a major river, Havenwood is directly in the path of the upriver surge. Its older flood protection systems are not equipped to handle the rapid-onset flash flood, leading to significant damage.

As a coastal port city with significant tsunami defenses, Port St. Jude is more resilient to a sea-based surge. However, its expansive, low-lying coastal areas still suffer damage, and residents lose trust in the city's ability to protect them from the unexpected.
Whispering Pines, being inland and at a high elevation, is not affected by the upriver surge. Their score reflects a minor impact from supply chain issues, but no direct damage.

scenarios.title: The Hundred-Year Flood
scenarios.description: Following sustained rainfall, a river crests and over-tops its banks, flooding the downtown area due to a lack of levee maintenance.

impacts.impactDescription: Havenwood's downtown area is centered around the river and is highly vulnerable to this type of large-scale flooding. The event was predicted, and the public's loss of trust is a major component of its negative score.

The city's extensive, low-lying industrial parks and public infrastructure are exposed to this large-scale flooding. The lack of proper maintenance on flood defenses is a major factor in the high resilience score.

Due to its high elevation, Whispering Pines is less exposed to a river-based flood. However, the heavy rainfall still leads to localized flash flooding and mudslides, resulting in significant disruption to daily life and loss of public trust.

scenarios.title: The WUI Fire
scenarios.description: A fire ignites in the Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI), rapidly spreading and consuming homes built without fire-resistant materials.

impacts.impactDescription: Havenwood's outer suburbs are built on the edge of a large, dry forest, making it highly susceptible to a WUI fire. The lack of proper fire-resistant building codes and evacuation plans is reflected in the high resilience score.

Port St. Jude's sprawling suburban areas are at the highest risk from a WUI fire. Many newly constructed homes have been built with minimal attention to fire safety, creating a highly vulnerable population and infrastructure.

As a town located in a national forest, Whispering Pines has the most experience with wildfires. They are not as susceptible as the other towns because of their 'defensible space' programs and early warning systems.

scenarios.title: The Industrial Park Fire
scenarios.description: A massive blaze breaks out in a chemical storage facility, threatening a nearby neighborhood and releasing toxic smoke into the air.

impacts.impactDescription: Havenwood has a large industrial park, which makes it a high risk for this type of event. It also has a densely populated residential area adjacent to the industrial park, increasing the risk of harm to the population.

Port St. Jude is home to a major port and many chemical storage facilities, making it the most vulnerable city to a fire of this nature. The toxic smoke would also have an outsized impact on the large population living near the port.

As a small, inland town with no major industrial sites, Whispering Pines has the lowest risk of a fire of this nature. The high negative trust score reflects the difficulty of getting help to the remote town.

scenarios.title: Chronic Erosion
scenarios.description: The town's primary beach and a key coastal highway are threatened by slow, continuous erosion.

impacts.impactDescription: Although inland, Havenwood relies heavily on its river for commerce and transportation, making it vulnerable to the downstream effects of chronic erosion. The local economy is not well-diversified and a coastal disaster would have a ripple effect.

Port St. Jude is a coastal city with a major tourism economy that is largely dependent on its beaches. It is also more susceptible to coastal erosion, so the city faces the highest risk from this disaster.

As a small inland town, Whispering Pines has the lowest risk of a coastal storm. Their resilience to this type of event is high, and the negative score reflects a minor impact from supply chain issues.

scenarios.title: The Hurricane
scenarios.description: A powerful Category 4 hurricane makes a direct landfall, causing widespread power outages, wind damage, and flooding.

impacts.impactDescription: Havenwood, though inland, is situated on a large river, which floods from the massive rainfall. The town's grid is also vulnerable to high winds, making it highly susceptible to a major power outage.

As a coastal city, Port St. Jude is directly impacted by the storm surge, high winds, and flooding. The city's aging infrastructure and heavy reliance on the port for its economy make it the most vulnerable city to a hurricane.

The inland location of Whispering Pines protects it from the worst effects of a hurricane. However, the town's power grid is still susceptible to high winds, and its remote location can cause problems for relief efforts.

designSolutions.name: Seismic Retrofitting
designSolutions.description: Strengthens existing buildings and infrastructure to withstand seismic activity, reducing structural damage and saving lives.

designSolutions.name: Levee & Floodwall Upgrades
designSolutions.description: Reinforces riverbanks and coastal defenses to protect against storm surges and large-scale flooding events.

designSolutions.name: Defensible Space Program
designSolutions.description: Clears vegetation around homes and uses fire-resistant materials to create a buffer zone against wildfires.

designSolutions.name: Utility Grid Hardening
designSolutions.description: Buries power lines and reinforces critical infrastructure to withstand extreme weather and maintain power during a disaster.

designSolutions.name: Smart Building Codes
designSolutions.description: Updates local construction codes to require modern materials and design principles that enhance resilience to specific natural disasters.

responseSolutions.name: Public Safety Campaign
responseSolutions.description: Educates citizens on preparedness, evacuation routes, and what to do during and after a disaster.

responseSolutions.name: Modern Early Warning System
responseSolutions.description: Installs sensors and sirens to provide real-time alerts about impending floods, fires, or seismic events.

responseSolutions.name: Emergency Supply Stockpile
responseSolutions.description: Builds and maintains a secure cache of food, water, medical supplies, and generators for post-disaster use.

responseSolutions.name: Post-Disaster Relief Funds
responseSolutions.description: Establishes a fund to provide immediate financial aid to residents and small businesses affected by a disaster.

modifiers.name: State Infrastructure Investment
modifiers.description: A new state-funded project provides additional resources, accelerating your progress.

modifiers.name: NIMBY Citizens
modifiers.description: A highly vocal group of citizens protests the new construction, causing delays and public friction.

modifiers.name: Efficient Supply Chain
modifiers.description: A recently optimized supply chain delivers materials ahead of schedule.

modifiers.name: Budget Cuts
modifiers.description: Funding is unexpectedly reduced, forcing you to scale back the project's scope.
